name: AlphaGenome 2
description: A conditional DNA sequence model that predicts gene expression, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility and DNA methylation for one tissue, cell type or cell state at a time, from a one-million-letter DNA sequence and a condition taken from a reference catalog or generated from a user's single-cell data by a cell encoder.

attributes.access: Available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, and in private preview for commercial research via Google Cloud.
